scope: Physical-correction accounting audit; existing F135 XML and thermal equations deliberately retained.
coefficientProvenance: All numerical gas/capacity/conductance/area/emissivity values are reduced-model hypotheses authored in the preceding thermal/rebuild work. Public references do not measure these F135 quantities. No fitting to desired glow was done here.

equations.n: N2/100; shaft-speed fraction, not temperature or color.
equations.nozzleMassFlowKgPerS: 120*n^2*(pt/2116.22)*sqrt(288.15/TATK); scheduled flow proxy, not a solved compressor map.
equations.coreGasBathK: Existing native legacy EGT(degC)+273.15; run schedule includes ambient+363.1+normalized_N2*357.1; phase logic supplies starting/off behavior. This is a turbine-exit proxy, not combustor temperature.
equations.linerGasBathK: Nozzle mixture energy estimate with actual AB-gated excess fuel, declared cp 1150 J/(kg K), LHV 43.3 MJ/kg, AB efficiency 0.95, reference 298.15 K and oxygen-limit FAR 0.068; supplied but unburned excess remains in mixture mass.
equations.radiationSurroundings: TATK reservoir; effective bolometric area/view coupling, not ray-traced geometry. Core flame area 0; liner flame area 1 m2 and epsFlame 0.05 while actually augmented.

capacities.meaning: Effective lumped C, constant in this F135 model. No density/alloy cp or mesh mass is supplied or inferred.
capacities.priorIllustration: The preceding audit illustrated 1800 J/K as 3 kg * 600 J/(kg K). That dimensional factorization is not a measured mass, material identification or calibration and does not associate rendered geometry volume with stored energy.

energyBoundary.solved: Separate local signed heat/storage balances and an optional independent AB nozzle gas mixing estimate.
energyBoundary.imposed: Gas, coolant and surroundings temperatures; no finite reservoir depletion. Solid heat is not subtracted from gas or native fuel.
absent: Direct core-to-liner conduction or radiation/view-factor network
Coolant mass flow and return enthalpy
Feedback from emitted visible-light shader power into native heat
energyBoundary.doubleCounting: Native flame absorption and surroundings loss are already in each wall balance. Optical emitted-power diagnostics are observers, not additional wall losses. No sum of native fuel W, gas bath W, wall radiation W and optical bounds is labeled a closed global budget.
energyBoundary.opticalEmissivity: The visible optical grey-body table is a separate spectral approximation. Native eps 0.8/0.75 are bolometric effective exchange coefficients; agreement of full optical and thermal spectra is not established.

initialization.cold: Stopped, uninitialized native engine. First real step refreshes local ambient; recorded assigned initialization energy separates this refresh from integrated heat. Then actual starter/spool/legacy EGT drive both solids.
initialization.running: Explicit engineRunning:true invokes InitRunning. First accepted step seeds thermal equilibrium; externally assigned energy is recorded, transient integrated heat zero. This is not a cold-start experiment.
initialization.hotRestart: Existing initialized hot state retained through shutdown and real starter; no new equilibrium seed.
initialization.pause: Same-time native hold/suspension/RunIC/render reads retain state and do not integrate heat. Hold may retain cached prior receipt; consumer must use accepted simulation time.
initialization.location: Application stopped-hot hold-down runway relocation preserves both solid temperatures and stopped/fuel-zero state; next-step continuity checked.

uncertainty.brackets: Individual factors 0.5–2 for C,Hg,Hc,A and coolant rise; bolometric eps 0.4–0.95; gas bath±100K; flame eps 0, 0.025, 0.1. These are deliberate sensitivity stress brackets, not measured confidence intervals.
uncertainty.result: Capacity affects lag/storage but not steady equilibrium. Weak cooling and hot bath choices dominate core equilibrium; AB gas/flame hypotheses dominate liner. No parameters retuned.

preserved: 28k/43k development propulsion ratings, coupled powered-lift allocations, throttle/fuel/spool/EGT/nozzle schedules and operational AB inhibition unchanged. Prior rating discrepancy remains in reconstruction audit.

qualification.checks: All 133577 accepted steps independently reconstruct rates and energy; four timestep cooldowns compared with separately refined explicit RK4.
qualification.scope: Software/local numerical balance and documented assumptions, not measured hardware, global energy, GPU or photographed-color acceptance.
